# La Victoria Berlin

> Peruvian restaurant in Berlin serving authentic Lima street food at Markthalle Pfefferberg, Prenzlauer Berg.

## Key facts

- Cuisine: Peruvian street food (Lima style)
- Address: Markthalle Pfefferberg, Schönhauser Allee 176, 10119 Berlin (Prenzlauer Berg)
- Opening hours: Tuesday–Sunday 12:00–21:00; closed Monday
- Reservations: not taken, walk-in only
- Public transport: U2 Senefelderplatz (5 min walk), U8 Rosenthaler Platz (8 min), Tram M2/M8 Eberswalder Str. (3 min)
- Google rating: 4.8 / 5
- Contact: info@lavictoriaberlin.com
- Allergen information is listed for every dish on the menu

## Dishes

- Anticucho: grilled marinated skewers served with potato and choclo (Peruvian corn)
- Ceviche: raw fish cured in lime juice with red onion and rocoto chili, served cold
- Papa Rellena: fried potato dough filled with seasoned beef, onion and egg, with salsa criolla
- Pan con Chicharrón: sandwich with pork belly, sweet potato and salsa criolla
- Pollo a la Brasa: sandwich with smoked chicken, lettuce, tomato, salsa amarilla and shoestring potatoes
- Salchipapa: fries with sliced sausage, chilimayo and chimichurri
- Sides and drinks: fries, alfajor, chicha morada
